author: Gretchen Ives
title: Looking for cover artist for workplace romance trilogy
content: Calling all romance book illustrators! I’m looking for a cover artist for my new workplace romance trilogy series. Currently just looking to order one cover but ideally someone I could work with for several. I need someone who has current availability as this is somewhat urgent, a previous illustrator fell through. Absolutely NO AI please! Would love to see your portfolios. Contact via DM.

author: V.M. Sawh
title: Indie author seeking character artists for dark fantasy book
content: Attn Artists: I'm an Indie Author looking for experienced character artists for an exciting 2027 dark fantasy book with 10+ full page colour illustrations in a 6x9" hardcover interior. Artists, please link your portfolios. Criteria: 1) NO AI. Real artists only 2) Your portfolio must include at least one Creature/Werewolf/Demon and one Beautiful Woman to be considered 3) Semi/Realistic Illustrations (colour and B&W) 4) Canadian Artists preferred 5) Vibe Check: https://pin.it/15teNuksT Contact by linking portfolios in replies.
